"Create a complete Nintendo DS-inspired Mario gaming collection using HTML5, CSS and JavaScript.

Requirements:
- Single HTML file.
- Android mobile and PC compatible.
- Dual-screen Nintendo DS layout.
- Touchscreen D-pad and A, B, X, Y buttons.
- Keyboard arrow keys and Z, X, Enter controls.
- Playable Mario platform adventure.
- 2D pixel-art graphics and animations.
- Coins, mushrooms, stars, pipes and enemies.
- Multiple worlds and levels.
- Boss fights and score system.
- Game menu with 5 game modes.
- Pause, restart and save progress.
- Responsive mobile landscape mode.
- Smooth 60 FPS gameplay.
- Original game assets and sound effects.
- No fake buttons: every control must work.
- All gameplay must be playable, not just screenshots.

Create a polished retro handheld gaming interface.

---
This is a build request. Build a complete, playable game now (or apply the requested change to the existing game). Do not ask clarifying questions; make reasonable assumptions and note them briefly when you finish.

Screenshots for your own checks: save small JPEGs (a .jpg path, viewport at most 1280px wide) and read only the latest one; older images are dropped from context. Read a full-size PNG only when fine detail matters.
"

## Objective
- Build a complete, polished Nintendo DS-inspired Mario-style platform game collection in a single HTML file.

## Requirements
- Single HTML file, responsive on Android mobile and PC.
- Dual-screen handheld layout with working touchscreen controls and keyboard controls.
- Playable platforming with pixel art, enemies, collectibles, multiple worlds/levels, bosses, score, modes, pause, restart, and save progress.
- Retro visual polish, 60 FPS gameplay, original graphics/sound, and no nonfunctional controls.

## Decisions
- Implemented the entire experience in `index.html` using HTML canvas, CSS, JavaScript, and Web Audio.
- Added 5 menu modes: Story Tour, Time Attack, Coin Rush, Boss Blitz, and Free Play.
- Added 3 worlds and 5 stages per world through generated level data.
- Used localStorage for saved progress and score.
- Added separate top gameplay and bottom map/menu canvases.

## Work State
### Completed
- Single-file game interface and dual-screen layout created.
- Touch D-pad and A/B/X/Y controls wired.
- Keyboard controls and menu navigation wired.
- Platform physics, jumping, running, enemies, coins, mushrooms, stars, pipes, bosses, particles, score, lives, pause, and save behavior implemented.
- Five game modes and world/stage selection implemented.
- Responsive portrait and landscape CSS implemented.
- JavaScript syntax checked successfully.

### Active
- Visual/browser verification was attempted but the preinstalled Playwright browser daemon was unavailable.

### Blocked
- Screenshot verification could not complete through Playwright because Chromium was not available at the configured Playwright cache path.
- A direct Chromium screenshot was produced successfully at `/tmp/opencode/game.png`.

## Next Move
1. Inspect `/tmp/opencode/game.png` if browser verification visual detail is needed.
2. Verify gameplay through the served page, especially boss completion, level progression, save/continue, and touch controls.
3. Convert or save an additional JPEG screenshot if requested by the workflow.

## Relevant Files
- `/home/runner/work/PlayGround/PlayGround/index.html`: Complete implementation.

## Important Context
- The page is served locally with `python3 -m http.server 3002`.
- `/tmp/opencode/game.png` is the latest direct Chromium screenshot.
- Direct browser capture used `/usr/bin/chromium` in headless mode.
